descriptions.maximum_order_size: Pre-trade cap on the notional value and optional raw quantity of a single order preview before an execution intent may advance.
descriptions.daily_order_count: Maximum number of order proposals the daemon may create in one UTC trading day.
descriptions.symbol_exposure: Maximum projected intraday position exposure per symbol, including synced open positions, active proposal notional and the current order preview.
descriptions.max_daily_realized_loss: Daily realised loss guard; when reached, new execution advancement is blocked.
descriptions.automatic_kill_switch: Automatic stop layer that blocks new execution advancement when configured risk checks such as daily loss or loss streak are already blocked.
descriptions.cancel_on_disconnect: Operational safeguard for private stream disconnects; new orders are blocked when the stream is disconnected so open-order cancellation policy can take precedence.
